prompt: A school has 1,200 students. Of these students, 45 percent ride the bus, and one third of the bus riders are in ninth grade. How many ninth graders ride the bus?
The number x is 50 percent greater than the number y, and y is 40 percent less than the number z. The number x is what percent of z?

Kai and Lia each run at a constant speed. In the time it takes Kai to run 500 meters, Lia runs 400 meters. They start a 1,500-meter race together. When Kai crosses the finish line, how many meters is Lia behind him?
At a market, 3 apples cost the same as 4 pears, and 2 pears cost the same as 5 plums. How many plums cost the same as 6 apples?

Fifteen friends agree to share the $420 cost of renting a bus equally. Three of them drop out, and the other friends share the same $420 cost equally. How much more does each remaining friend pay than under the original plan?
A prize is shared among Ana, Ben and Cal in the ratio 2 : 3 : 5. Cal then gives one quarter of his share to Ana. What percent of the whole prize does Ana now have?

Box A and box B hold pencils in the ratio 5 : 3. After 12 pencils are moved from box A to box B, the ratio of the number of pencils in box A to the number in box B is 7 : 5. How many pencils are in box B now?

Towns P and Q are 330 kilometers apart. A train leaves P at 9:00 a.m. and travels toward Q at 60 kilometers per hour. A second train leaves Q at 10:30 a.m. and travels toward P on a parallel track at 90 kilometers per hour. At what time do the two trains pass each other?

Two partners divide a profit as follows. First, Mina receives 10 percent of the profit as a management fee. Then the rest of the profit is split between Mina and Joon in the ratio 2 : 3. Mina receives $2,300 in all. How many dollars does Joon receive?

Two candles are the same length. One burns down completely in 4 hours and the other in 6 hours, each at a steady rate. Both are lit at the same moment. After how long is the slower-burning candle exactly twice as long as the faster-burning candle?

A crew planned to pave 20 kilometers of road in 40 days, paving the same distance each day. After 15 days, only 6 kilometers have been paved. To finish on schedule, by what percent must the crew's daily distance for the remaining days exceed the originally planned daily distance?
The price of a box of cereal rises by 20 percent. At the same time, the amount of cereal in the box is reduced by 20 percent. By what percent does the price per ounce of the cereal increase?
A 60-kilogram load of fresh fruit is 75 percent water by weight. After drying, the fruit is 40 percent water by weight. What is the weight of the dried fruit, in kilograms?
Brand A rice is sold in 250-gram bags for $3.00, and brand B rice is sold in 400-gram bags for $4.40. How much less does 1 kilogram of brand B rice cost than 1 kilogram of brand A rice?

Walking from home to the station at 4 kilometers per hour, Ravi arrives 7 minutes after his train has left. Walking at 6 kilometers per hour, he arrives 5 minutes before the train leaves. The train leaves at the same time each day. How many kilometers is it from his home to the station?

Lines l and m are parallel, and point P lies between them. Point A is on line l and point B is on line m, and both A and B lie to the left of P. Segment PA makes an acute angle of 35 degrees with line l, and segment PB makes an acute angle of 50 degrees with line m. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle APB?
A lamp post is 18 feet tall. A person who is 6 feet tall stands on level ground 10 feet from the base of the post. How long, in feet, is the shadow that the lamp casts of the person?
The base of a cylinder has a circumference of 10pi centimeters, and the cylinder is 6 centimeters tall. What is the volume of the cylinder, in cubic centimeters?
In right triangle ABC, the right angle is at C. The altitude from C meets the hypotenuse AB at point D, with AD = 4 and DB = 9. What is the area of triangle ABC?
ABCDE is a regular pentagon, and diagonal AC is drawn. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle BAC?

A garden is shaped like a rectangle measuring 10 meters by 6 meters with a semicircle attached outward along each of the two 6-meter sides, each 6-meter side being a diameter of its semicircle. Using 3.14 for pi, what is the perimeter of the garden, in meters?
A square and an equilateral triangle have the same perimeter. The area of the square is 36 square centimeters. What is the area of the triangle, in square centimeters?
Each side of a regular pentagon measures 4 centimeters. A square has the same perimeter as the pentagon. What is the area of the square, in square centimeters?
The sum of the measures of the interior angles of a polygon is 1,440 degrees. How many diagonals does the polygon have?
A rhombus has a perimeter of 40 centimeters, and one of its diagonals is 12 centimeters long. What is the area of the rhombus, in square centimeters?

A square is drawn inside a right triangle whose legs measure 6 and 4. One corner of the square is at the right angle, two sides of the square lie along the legs, and the opposite corner of the square lies on the hypotenuse. What is the side length of the square?

A rectangular box measuring 2 centimeters by 3 centimeters by 4 centimeters is completely covered with a layer of clay 1 centimeter thick on every face, so that the clay and the box together form a larger rectangular box. What is the volume of the clay, in cubic centimeters?
A bagel shop sells 5 kinds of bagel and 3 kinds of spread. Each order is one bagel together with either exactly one spread or no spread at all. How many different orders are possible?
How many three-digit positive integers have exactly one digit equal to 7?

The letters A, B, C, D and E are arranged in a row in a random order, with every arrangement equally likely. What is the probability that A is somewhere to the left of B and B is somewhere to the left of C? (The letters need not be next to each other.)

Each of the 50 students in a club plays at least one of three games: chess, checkers and go. 30 students play chess, 22 play checkers and 18 play go. Exactly 6 students play all three games. How many students play exactly two of the games?
On a quiz, 6 students scored 70, 5 students scored 80, and k students scored 90. No other scores were recorded. The median of all the scores is 80. What is the greatest possible value of k?

In a class of 50 students, 28 take Spanish, 20 take French, and 8 take both languages. A student who takes exactly one of the two languages is chosen at random. What is the probability that the student takes Spanish?
A three-digit number is formed using only the digits 1 through 9, and digits may be repeated. How many such numbers are odd?
How many four-digit positive integers have digits that strictly increase from left to right (for example, 1358)?
A number is chosen at random from all the numbers between 0 and 20 on a number line, with every number equally likely. What is the probability that the number is closer to 4 than it is to 14?
A committee of 3 people is chosen at random from a group of 4 juniors and 5 seniors. What is the probability that exactly 2 of the people chosen are seniors?

Maya walks from corner P to corner Q of a street grid. Q is 5 blocks east and 3 blocks north of P, and on every block Maya walks either east or north. Her route must pass through the corner that is 2 blocks east and 2 blocks north of P. How many different routes can she take?

Bag A holds 3 red marbles and 1 blue marble. Bag B holds 1 red marble and 5 blue marbles. A fair six-sided die is rolled. If it shows 1 or 2, one marble is drawn at random from bag A; otherwise one marble is drawn at random from bag B. What is the probability that the marble drawn is red?
Seven more than 3 times a number is equal to 2 less than 5 times the number. What is the number?
What is the sum of all the integers x that satisfy |2x + 5| <= 9 ?
The larger of two numbers is 4 more than twice the smaller. Three times the larger number minus the smaller number equals 47. What is the sum of the two numbers?
The functions f and g are defined by f(x) = 2x + 3 and g(x) = x^2 - 1. What is the product of all values of x for which g(f(x)) = 48 ?
For all numbers a and b, the operation * is defined by a * b = 2a - 3b + ab. If 3 * x = x * 1, what is the value of x?
A geometric sequence of positive numbers has first term 3, and the sum of its first three terms is 39. What is the fourth term of the sequence?
Mia has twice as many stickers as Leo. After Mia gives Leo 12 of her stickers, Leo has 3 more stickers than Mia. How many stickers did Mia and Leo have together at the start?

Plan A for a phone costs $20 per month plus $0.05 per minute of calls. Plan B costs $8 per month plus $0.11 per minute. What is the least whole number of minutes in a month for which Plan A costs less than Plan B?
What value of x satisfies |x - 2| = 2x + 5 ?
Which of the following describes all values of x for which (x - 3)/4 - (x + 1)/6 > 1 ?
A function f is defined by f(x) = ax + b, where a and b are positive constants. If f(f(x)) = 4x + 9 for all x, what is the value of f(5)?
Line p passes through the points (0, 8) and (4, 0). Line q passes through the points (1, -1) and (3, 5). The two lines intersect at the point (a, b). What is the value of a + b?
In the coordinate plane, the graph of y = |x + 1| and the horizontal line y = 5 enclose a region. What is the area of that region, in square units?

Three ropes are 36 meters, 60 meters, and 150 meters long. All three ropes are cut into pieces that all have the same length, with no rope left over, and the pieces are made as long as possible. How many pieces are there in all?
What is the least positive integer n such that n/2 is a perfect square and n/3 is a perfect cube?
What is the greatest prime factor of 2^10 - 1?
How many positive divisors of 720 are multiples of 15?
How many integers from 1 to 150, inclusive, have an odd number of positive divisors?
What is the value of -3^2 + (-2)^3 - 4(-5)/2 ?
What is the value of (4.8 x 10^-3)(2.5 x 10^6) divided by (6 x 10^-4), written in scientific notation?
A positive number N rounds to 7.5 when it is rounded to the nearest tenth, and it rounds to 8 when it is rounded to the nearest whole number. Which of the following could be N?
